citation.title: Clinical performance, accuracy, and physical-mechanical properties of 3D-printed removable partial denture metal frameworks compared with conventionally and partially digitally produced frameworks: A systematic review
citation.authors: Alqutaibi AY, Al-Gabri RS, Al-Zaghruri AS, Farghal AE, Alnazzawi AA, Alghauli MA

s_design.anchor: Systematic review (no meta-analysis) of mainly in-vitro studies plus five clinical studies, primary aim fit/accuracy and physical-mechanical properties of frameworks (MATERIAL SR/MA row, 100)
s_design.evidence_quote: Both clinical and in-vitro studies were deemed eligible for inclusion.

domains.evidence_quote: The protocol for this systematic review was registered on the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO No: CRD42024597225).
A comprehensive search of electronic databases—including the PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library
domains.note: four bibliographic databases (PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library), above the 3b-i threshold of 2

domains.evidence_quote: although three records[42–44] were excluded because they did not evaluate the 3D-printed metal framework RPD
domains.note: 31 retrieved plus 2 added, 30 included: the three full-text exclusions are individually cited [42–44] with one specific, checkable shared reason (3b-iii item 1)

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: The laboratory studies included in this analysis were assessed for the risk of bias using a modified CONSORT tool
domains.note: clinical studies appraised with ROB2 and ROBINS-I; two assessors with a third for disagreement

domains.evidence_quote: A meta-analysis was not performed because of the considerable variability across studies
domains.note: no pooling; the choice of qualitative descriptive synthesis is stated and justified by heterogeneity of framework types, materials, technologies and printing parameters

absence: read Methods 2.1-2.5 (protocol, eligibility, search strategy and data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, data synthesis), Results 3.1-3.4 and Discussion including the GRADE paragraph (which lists study design, risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness and imprecision only); no publication bias, small-study effect, funnel plot or reporting-bias wording anywhere in the text. No meta-analysis was performed, but the fixed domain list has no not-applicable outcome and FULL_TEXT silence is high (3b rule 1)

penalties.item: no conflict-of-interest statement / commercial manufacturer funding
penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare that they have no known competing
penalties.note: competing-interest declaration present; the review states it received no funding

penalties.item: clinical trial not prospectively registered (RCTs only)
penalties.note: not applicable: the paper is a systematic review, not an RCT (its own protocol is PROSPERO-registered)

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: source text does not state a follow-up duration for any included clinical study and makes no survival claim from short follow-up; its clinical outcomes are satisfaction, retention, fit and adaptation, and the Discussion names long-term clinical outcomes only as a gap in the literature

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۵۵ است و در باند C (شواهد محدود) با نوع سؤال MATERIAL قرار می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: این مرور سیستماتیک پروتکل ثبت‌شده در PROSPERO، جست‌وجو در چهار پایگاه داده و ارزیابی risk of bias دارد اما publication bias را بررسی نکرده است. ۲۶ مطالعه in-vitro و فقط پنج مطالعه بالینی است. محور اصلی آن مقایسهٔ fit و خواص مکانیکی فریم‌ورک‌های SLM و DMLS با ریختگی سنتی است و خودش کمبود شواهد مقایسه‌ای بلندمدت را گزارش می‌کند.

citation.title: Accuracy assessment of removable partial denture frameworks fabricated by selective laser melting using two different workflows: A cross-over clinical study
citation.authors: Elgamal M, Ibrahim AM, Fadl BT, Ragheb NA

s_design.anchor: prospective non-randomized within-participant crossover clinical comparison of two fabrication workflows, no randomization reported (THERAPY prospective cohort / non-randomized trial row, 65)
s_design.evidence_quote: In this crossover study, each participant received two

domains.note: within-participant comparison; same design, technician, machinery and procedures for both workflows

domains.evidence_quote: The inclusion criteria for this study were as
domains.note: explicit inclusion criteria; every participant received both interventions, so selection cannot differ between arms

domains.evidence_quote: one fabricated using a combined analog-digital workflow (Group I) and the other
domains.note: both workflows defined step by step in Methods

domains.evidence_quote: each participant in specific areas, including occlusal

penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare no competing interests.

sources.fact_fa: این مطالعه امتیاز ۵۲ از ۱۰۰ و باند C (شواهد محدود) را در نوع پرسش THERAPY گرفت.
sources.interpretation_fa: یک کارآزمایی بالینی crossover غیرتصادفی روی ۲۴ بیمار Kennedy class I است که هر بیمار کنترل خودش بود و اندازهٔ نمونه با power analysis تعیین شد. امتیاز به‌خاطر نبود blinding ارزیاب، نرم‌افزار non-metrology grade و گزارش‌نشدن ریزش پایین آمد. پیامد اصلی fit فریم‌ورک است و برتری workflow تمام‌دیجیتال حدود ۰٫۰۱۱ میلی‌متر است.
